notes: tolower (110 B chunk, no pad; FPO fpo/esp cbProlog=9 cbRegs=2). Whole-body naked-asm escape: FA's prolog cmp ds:[__ctype+0x388],0 comes BEFORE push esi/push edi (CL's C route reorders or misframes the global-cmp-embedded prolog + __lock/__nstream counter dance). Fast path: 0x41..0x5a -> +0x20; slow path = cmp __nstream+4, je fresh (esi=0, inc __nstream+8) else push 0x13 / esi=1 / call __lock; [esp+0xc] -> call __tolower_lk; esi-steared unlock-vs-free tails share the pop edi/pop esi/ret at chunk end. All abs moffs (__ctype+0x388, __nstream+4, __nstream+8) ride CL's own asm-reloc HIGHLOWs - payload = FA_imm - symVA addends; rel32 calls need no newsites. No patches at all; emitted 110/110 B with zero diffs.

Linear scan over 0x18-B carrier slots from _airports+0x3020 (imm = symVA+0x3020 addend class) to _overflow_ptr end, empty-slot re-find pass, _curThing push (68 imm32 reloc), APSetOffset call, _curId store (66 a1 moffs). Zero patches: all encodings came from CL's assembler directly.

G_Polygon@8 (60 B = 59 code + census pad 90). Naked-asm escape: fastcall (cx=slot, edx=poly#) whose args PASS THROUGH to the callees (call sites push nothing - @G_SUPolygon@8 sees the same ecx/edx), and the G_UPolygon call is CF-conditional (jae 73 05 straight off the second call - no test in between; callee returns truth in CF) - both expressible only in asm. Stores: __right+0x14/0x10 (dword) and __right+0x7c (byte 0), dword cmp on _expandTerrain (83 3d moffs). Two interior call deltas via map TO '+delta' spelling (rel32, no .reloc entries).

WRWhitenPalette@12 (92 B = 90 code + census pad 8bc0). Naked-asm escape for the 16-bit band: movzx ax / sub ax,3f / imul bx / add [edi],ah x3 per pixel, ecx `loop` countdown; if step==0x100 (ebx==-... wait cmp ebx,0x100 je) the fill branch: ecx=3*count, mov al,0x3f, rep stosb, jmp epilog. CL's asm is byte-right for the loop band (0x00-0x14: prolog, arg loads, cmp/neg, je, first movzx/imul are identical); only the tail needed one in-place 69-B block patch. Tail pad 8b c0 is census-proven filler (no tail key needed).

sincos (62 B, no pad). Register-ABI fixed-point lerp helper (args/results in eax/ebx/ebp - callers pass angle in bx): ebx->slot index ((angle>>8 cleared bh)*2), then 4 movsx table reads; eax = (s1-s0)*cl>>8 + s0 (sin lerp from sin_table/sin_table+2), ebx = (c1-c0)*cl>>8 + c0 (cos lerp from cos_table/cos_table+2); bare ret. Naked-asm escape. Wave-31 [reg+symbol] base-drop wall: CL encodes all four `movsx, word ptr [ebx+sin_table]` refs base-DROPPED (0f bf 2d/05/1d forms, 7 B) - only the modrm byte differs from FA's [ebx+disp32] forms (ab/83/ab/9b), positions identical, so four 1-byte modrm patches fix it.
